purpose_text.para: Provides syndrome information to software for a trace buffer management event.

field_description.para: Management event Specific Syndrome 2. Contains syndrome specific to the management event.
The syndrome contents for each management event are described in the following sections.

fields.fields_instance: stage 1 or stage 2 Data Aborts on write to trace buffer

field_description.para: TopLevel. Indicates if the fault was due to TopLevel.

field_value_description.para: Fault is not due to TopLevel.
Fault is due to TopLevel.

field_description.para: AssuredOnly flag. If a memory access generates a stage 2 Data Abort, then this field holds information about the fault.

field_value_description.para: Data Abort is not due to AssuredOnly.
Data Abort is due to AssuredOnly.

field.fields_condition: When FEAT_THE is implemented, TRBSR_EL1.EC == '100101', and GetTRBSR_EL1_FSC() IN {'0011xx'}

field_description.para: Overlay flag. If a memory access generates a Data Abort for a Permission fault, then this field holds information about the fault.

field_value_description.para: Data Abort is not due to Overlay Permissions.
Data Abort is due to Overlay Permissions.

field.fields_condition: When (FEAT_S1POE is implemented or FEAT_S2POE is implemented) and GetTRBSR_EL1_FSC() IN {'0011xx'}

field_description.para: DirtyBit flag. If a write access to memory generates a Data Abort for a Permission fault using Indirect Permission, then this field holds information about the fault.

field_value_description.para: Permission Fault is not due to dirty state.
Permission Fault is due to dirty state.

field.fields_condition: When (FEAT_S1PIE is implemented or FEAT_S2PIE is implemented) and GetTRBSR_EL1_FSC() IN {'0011xx'}

field_description.para: Maintenance status. Indicates that a trace buffer management event has been recorded.
When FEAT_TRBE_EXC is implemented, this field indicates a management event for EL1.
If FEAT_TRBE_EXC is implemented and the TRBE Profiling exception for EL1 is enabled, then when this field is 1, a TRBE Profiling exception for EL1 is pending
If FEAT_TRBE_EXC is not implemented or the TRBE Profiling exception for EL1 is disabled, then this field drives the TRBIRQ trace buffer interrupt request signal.

field_value_description.para: No trace buffer management event for EL1 has been recorded.
A trace buffer management event for EL1 has been recorded.
No Detected Trigger has been observed since this field was last cleared to zero.
A Detected Trigger has been observed since this field was last cleared to zero.

field_description.para: For each byte of trace the Trace Buffer Unit Accepts and writes to the trace buffer at the address in the current write pointer, if the current write pointer is equal to the Limit pointer minus one, the current write pointer is wrapped by setting it to the Base pointer, and this field is set to 1.

field_value_description.para: The current write pointer has not wrapped since this field was last cleared to zero.
The current write pointer has wrapped since this field was last cleared to zero.

field_description.para: It is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED whether this field is set to 1 or is unchanged by the PE when a write by the Trace Buffer Unit generates an External abort on a translation table walk, translation table update, or GPT walk that is reported as an MMU fault. From Armv9.3, this field is not set to 1 by the PE for any other trace buffer management event.

field_value_description.para: An External abort has not been asserted.
An External abort has been asserted and detected by the Trace Buffer Unit.

field_value_description.para: Collection has not been stopped.

field_value_description.para: Collection not stopped, or access not allowed.

Trigger Event. Collection stopped because of a Trigger Event. See TRBTRG_EL1 for more information.
Manual Stop. Collection stopped because of a Manual Stop event. See TRBCR.ManStop for more information.
Buffer size. The requested trace buffer size was too large.

access_permission_text.para: The PE might ignore a write to TRBSR_EL1 if any of the following apply:

content.para: TRBLIMITR_EL1.E is 1, and either FEAT_TRBE_EXT is not implemented or the Trace Buffer Unit is using Self-hosted mode.
TRBLIMITR_EL1.XE is 1, FEAT_TRBE_EXT is implemented, and the Trace Buffer Unit is using External mode.
